name: Hotel-Garni Hubertushof
beschreibung: Hotel-Garni Hubertushof offers relaxing bed-and-breakfast hospitality in the scenic alpine setting near Innsbruck in Tyrol. Surrounded by forested slopes and mountains, it serves as a wonderful base for summer hiking trails and multiple regional ski resorts in winter. The rooms come equipped with balconies and free Wi-Fi. Additional facilities include an inviting sauna area, a generous breakfast lounge, and convenient private parking.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel-Garni Hubertushof in the Innsbruck area features peaceful bed-and-breakfast rooms with balconies, a relaxing sauna, and direct access to mountain activities.
